retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome composition featuring a large silhouette with an umbrella containing a smaller inset figure against a crashing wave background.
triggerTerms: crashing waves black and white photography
excludeWhen: minimalist flat vector style is requested
sunny or calm environments are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition dominated by a large, dark silhouette of a person holding an umbrella, standing on a rocky shore. Inside the silhouette's torso, a smaller, light-colored figure is visible. The background consists of high-contrast, grainy white sea spray and crashing waves under a pale sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Large dark silhouette vs. bright crashing waves
Small light figure nested within large dark figure
Geometric umbrella shape vs. organic water spray
Textured rocky foreground vs. fluid background motion

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large central silhouette occupies the middle third of the frame vertically, scaled to dominate the height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, angular umbrella at the top of the silhouette serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark umbrella, moves down the silhouette to the nested light figure, and then radiates outward to the crashing waves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright, textured sea spray acts as active negative space, framing the dark central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the primary silhouette and foreground rocks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white and light grays for the sea spray and sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for the nested figure and water textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the subject and background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' has a flat base with a separate underline stroke
Lowercase 'a' is constructed from a circle and a vertical bar with an underline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast juxtaposition of a heavy geometric sans-serif with a delicate, airy script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the technical, geometric feel of the base skeleton.
Provides the necessary contrast for the script overlay.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a person in a long coat holding an umbrella, seen from behind on a rocky shore. The background should be a wall of crashing white sea spray. Use a double exposure effect to place a smaller figure in a light-colored coat inside the main silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, semi-transparent geometric sans-serif title across the top. Overlay a thin, black cursive script title directly over the center of the first title.

verificationChecks: Is there a nested figure within the main silhouette?
Does the background feature high-contrast sea spray?
Are the two text layers overlapping correctly?

mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital clean gradients; maintain photographic grain
Ensure the script text remains legible despite the overlap
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between silhouette and spray
Verify the presence of the underline graphic device in the typography
Ensure the grain texture is consistent across the frame
Confirm the nested figure is clearly visible within the dark area
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast silhouette containing a secondary image with a background of chaotic natural motion, topped with layered, contrasting typographic styles.
